notebooks.title: Measure waves, then build interference
notebooks.subtitle: From centimetres to detection probabilities
notebooks.description: Measure a travelling ripple, add two wave displacements, and reproduce the lesson's 16-bin quantum screen with and without a path record.
learningGoals: Read amplitude, wavelength, and frequency from labelled plots.
Predict reinforcement and cancellation before computing a probability.
Explain why a single detection differs from a probability distribution.

notebooks.title: Turn amplitude lists into probabilities
notebooks.subtitle: Ordered vectors, complex magnitudes, and normalization
notebooks.description: Compare probability lists with amplitude lists, draw a complex amplitude, normalize an unscaled vector, and check predictions against repeated samples.
learningGoals: Keep outcome labels attached to vector entries.
Calculate a complex amplitude's squared magnitude.
Normalize a nonzero vector and verify that its probabilities sum to one.

notebooks.title: Find the information probabilities miss
notebooks.subtitle: Complex arrows, relative phase, and a new measurement basis
notebooks.description: Rotate complex amplitudes without changing their lengths, compare states with identical direct probabilities, and make their relative phase visible by measuring in a different basis.
learningGoals: Distinguish a complex arrow's length from its angle.
Explain why identical probabilities need not mean identical states.
Check that a shared global phase leaves all measurement predictions unchanged.
